description: When a runway's RVR reading heard at a time stops being the runway's: ten minutes after it was heard. AIM 7-1-13 has RVR 'updated approximately once every minute', so a reading not followed in ten is one the system or the feed stopped sending; a design bound that errs toward no RVR, the pilot then taking the visibility (14 CFR 91.175(h)(1)).

heard.description: When it was heard, Unix seconds.

ends.description: When it is no longer the runway's RVR, Unix seconds.
